SIGN_IN_TITLE: Sign in to the Platform Console
SIGN_IN_DESCRIPTION: Use your Arclayer identity, then complete Platform security verification.
CREDENTIALS_DESCRIPTION: Your Product Application session is not used here.
SECURITY_KEY_SETUP_DESCRIPTION: Add a security key or passkey before entering the Platform Console.
ADD_SECURITY_KEY_TO_CONTINUE: Add a security key or passkey
USE_SECURITY_KEY_OR_PASSKEY: Use a security key or passkey
AUTHENTICATOR_APP_SETUP_REQUIRED: Set up an authenticator app to protect Platform access on this account.
AUTHENTICATOR_SETUP_DESCRIPTION: Add this secret to your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
VERIFICATION_CODE_DESCRIPTION: Enter the current code from your authenticator app.
VERIFICATION_CODE_RETRY: Check the current code and try again.
RECOVERY_CODES_DESCRIPTION: Each code works once if you lose access to your authenticator app. They will not be shown again.
RECOVERY_CODES_SAVED_CONFIRMATION: I saved these recovery codes in a secure place.
SIGN_OUT_DESCRIPTION: The Platform Console will ask the server to revoke this device Session before removing the local credential.
SIGN_OUT_CONSEQUENCE: This does not sign out Product Application Sessions or revoke other Platform devices.
SIGN_OUT_ERROR: This device was not signed out
SIGN_OUT_UNCHANGED: The server did not confirm Session revocation, so the local credential remains available. Retry the same request or use the Sessions page from another device.
ERROR_TITLE: Access information could not be loaded
ERROR_DESCRIPTION: The Console could not confirm the current Platform state.
PERMISSION_TITLE: This Platform account cannot view this information
PERMISSION_DESCRIPTION: Ask the Instance Owner or an authorized Platform Operator for access.
EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: The server returned no records for this view.
TEAM_DESCRIPTION: Review the Instance Owner, Platform Operators, and invitations that are waiting or no longer effective.
INVITE_OPERATOR_DESCRIPTION: Choose an existing account and the Platform roles it should receive after acceptance and security setup.
PERSON_SEARCH_HELP: Search active Arclayer accounts by name, email, or username.
PERSON_SEARCH_ERROR: People could not be loaded. Close this dialog and try again.
INVITE_ROLES_HELP: The invitation is rechecked against the current role revisions when it is accepted.
OPERATOR_INVITED: The operator invitation was sent and is now waiting for acceptance.
INVITE_REQUIRED_FIELDS: Choose a person and at least one role.
ACTION_FAILED: The change could not be completed
ACTION_ERROR: The Platform did not apply this change. Review the current state and try again.
ACTION_PERMISSION_ERROR: Your current Platform authority does not allow this change.
ACTION_CONFLICT_ERROR: The team changed while this action was open. Refresh and review the latest state.
ACTION_VALIDATION_ERROR: Review the selected person, roles, and expiry.
OWNER_DESCRIPTION: One person holds this non-delegable responsibility.
OPERATORS_DESCRIPTION: Current access status, role coverage, security readiness, and device activity.
INVITATIONS_DESCRIPTION: Review pending invitations and those that are no longer effective.
INVITATION_DESCRIPTION: Review the identity, role outcome, and current invitation status.
ROLES_DESCRIPTION: Review the reusable role catalog and its current responsibilities.
ROLE_CATALOG_DESCRIPTION: Built-in and custom role revisions currently defined for this deployment.
PERMISSION_CATALOG_DESCRIPTION: Descriptions come from the server-owned catalog.
SIGN_IN_READINESS_DESCRIPTION: Review the current registration policy and identity-provider readiness.
IDENTITY_PROVIDERS_DESCRIPTION: Installed providers and their current configuration state.
SESSIONS_DESCRIPTION: Review this account’s verified security methods and active Platform devices.
MFA_DESCRIPTION: Only safe method labels and verification status are shown.
MFA_PAGE_DESCRIPTION: Review the security methods that protect this Platform account.
MFA_EMPTY: No verified security methods are available.
DEVICE_SESSIONS_DESCRIPTION: Current device sessions are shown without token or fingerprint details.
REVOKE_OTHER_SESSIONS_DESCRIPTION: Every other Platform device session will stop working on its next request. This device and Product Application sessions stay signed in.
REVOKE_CURRENT_SESSION_DESCRIPTION: The Platform session on {{device}} will stop working immediately and this Console will return to sign-in. Product Application sessions are unchanged.
REVOKE_SESSION_DESCRIPTION: The Platform session on {{device}} will stop working on its next request. Other Platform and Product Application sessions are unchanged.
SESSION_REVOKE_CONSEQUENCE: This action also invalidates security verification bound to the revoked Platform session. It does not remove the operator or change roles.
OTHER_SESSIONS_REVOKED: The other device sessions were revoked
SESSION_REVOKE_SUCCESS_DESCRIPTION: The server confirmed the change and the active device list has been refreshed.
SESSION_REVOKE_ERROR: The device session could not be revoked
SESSION_REVOKE_PERMISSION_ERROR: Your current Platform access cannot revoke this session
SESSION_REVOKE_UNCHANGED: The server did not apply the change. Review the diagnostic code and try again from the current device list.
SESSIONS_EMPTY: No active Platform sessions are recorded.
